aiTexts: Celebrate with the LONGCHAMP 70th Anniversary Embroidery Tote Bag, featuring a stylish half-moon shape and large capacity design.
Made with lace material and nylon lining, it offers a medium to soft hardness for comfortable daily use.
Waterproof and casual style, ideal for commuters and moms seeking both fashion and practicality.
Perfect for summer 2025 with multiple color options, suitable for daily matching and versatile occasions.

3198181221.detail_text: Compact, versatile and with pockets to boot, this is a better-designed version of your everyday, around-town tote. Small, essential and inherently useful, the City Tote makes a perfect sidekick for cruising around town. It’s lightweight and durable, with two internal slip pockets that keep your phone, keys and other must-haves in easy reach. The handles are long enough for over-shoulder carry, and short enough that you can carry the tote in-hand without it dragging. The flat bottom panel lets it stand upright on its own for easy packing, while still allowing the tote to fold into a neat little square.
